caption:
Supreme Court to weigh whether Trump asylum changes deny due process

Donald Trump · Politics

NPR reports an asylum ban, mass firings and new legal maneuvers have all but ended asylum in the US. Advocates are looking to the Supreme Court to restore asylum. The court will soon consider whether some of the shifts deny people due process.

Reported by NPR.
